name: smwsprites-moving-ledge-hole-v1
title: Moving Ledge Hole v1.1
description:
The moving ledge hole sprite seen in SMW ghost houses, disassembled and commented.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

v1.1 (KevinM):
- Fixed "act as" in the CFG file.
- Added fix from LM 2.53+ that prevents the sprite from teleporting one screen down when placed on a vertical screen boundary.
- Fixed issue on SA-1 where the sprite would only interact with the first 12 sprite slots.
